water-supply-engineer.name: Water Supply Engineer
water-supply-engineer.description: Engineers who plan, design, and supervise water distribution systems and treatment facilities.
responsibilities: Design water pipe networks and pumping stations
Perform hydraulic simulation and network optimization
Ensure compliance with drinking water quality standards
Coordinate with municipal authorities and EPC contractors

hydraulic-modelling-engineer.name: Hydraulic Modelling Specialist
hydraulic-modelling-engineer.description: Specialists focused on numerical modeling of pressurized water networks, surges, and storm water drainage.
responsibilities: Calibrate hydraulic models against field flow/pressure measurements
Simulate transient pressure surges (water hammer)
Analyze extended period simulations and water age

network-design-engineer.name: Network Design Engineer
network-design-engineer.description: Focuses on spatial alignment, pipe material selection, and CAD/BIM drafting for utility distribution.
responsibilities: Prepare utility alignment drawings and crossing details
Perform quantity takeoff and cost estimation

rc-design-engineer.name: Reinforced Concrete Structural Design Engineer
rc-design-engineer.description: Specialized structural engineer designing reinforced concrete beams, columns, slabs, shear walls, and foundation systems.
responsibilities: Perform RC section flexure, shear, and torsion capacity calculations
Design ductile frame detailing for earthquake resistance per ACI 318 / BNBC
Generate bar bending schedules (BBS) and structural CAD/BIM rebar drawings
Conduct structural health monitoring and FRP strengthening assessments

structural-engineer.name: Structural Design Engineer
structural-engineer.description: Engineers responsible for analyzing, designing, and detailing building structures and infrastructure frames.
responsibilities: Perform 3D structural analysis in ETABS, STAAD.Pro, or SAP2000
Design RC beams, columns, shear walls, and foundations per code
Prepare structural calculations and sign off on design documents
Coordinate with architectural, MEP, and site construction teams

structural-analyst.name: Structural Analysis & FEA Specialist
structural-analyst.description: Advanced structural specialist performing non-linear finite element modeling, dynamic dynamic response analysis, and stability checks.
responsibilities: Perform dynamic modal analysis and time-history earthquake simulation
Evaluate non-linear material behavior and progressive collapse risks
Provide expert analysis reports for high-rise and complex infrastructure

steel-design-engineer.name: Steel Structure Design Engineer
steel-design-engineer.description: Engineers specializing in heavy industrial steel buildings, trusses, portal frames, and complex bolted/welded connections.
responsibilities: Design structural steel framing per AISC 360 / Eurocode 3
Design moment, shear, and base plate steel connections
Review Tekla steel shop drawings and fabrication models

seismic-design-engineer.name: Seismic & Earthquake Engineering Specialist
seismic-design-engineer.description: Engineers specializing in earthquake-resistant design, response spectrum procedures, base isolation, and damper systems.
responsibilities: Evaluate site-specific seismic hazard criteria
Design lateral force resisting systems (LFRS) with high ductility
Conduct pushover analysis and performance-based seismic design

structural-bim-engineer.name: Structural BIM & Detailing Engineer
structural-bim-engineer.description: Engineers building 3D parametric BIM models, generating rebar schedules, and performing clash detection in Revit and Tekla.
responsibilities: Develop 3D structural BIM models in Revit and Tekla Structures
Extract structural construction drawings and bar bending schedules (BBS)
Perform multi-disciplinary clash detection with MEP and Architecture

bridge-structural-engineer.name: Bridge Structural Design Engineer
bridge-structural-engineer.description: Engineers designing highway and railway bridge superstructures, piers, abutments, and deep pile foundations.
responsibilities: Model bridge decks, prestressed girders, and piers in MIDAS Civil / SAP2000
Analyze moving traffic loads, wind dynamics, and temperature effects
Design deep pile foundations and elastomeric bearing pads

geotechnical-engineer.name: Geotechnical Engineer
geotechnical-engineer.description: Professional engineer responsible for evaluating earth materials, designing foundations, slopes, and retaining systems.
responsibilities: Plan and supervise geotechnical subsurface investigations
Interpret SPT, CPT, and lab test results to derive design soil parameters
Design shallow footings, deep pile foundations, and retaining walls
Prepare geotechnical investigation and design reports

foundation-engineer.name: Foundation Design Engineer
foundation-engineer.description: Specialist engineer focused on structural and geotechnical design of shallow mats, deep bored/driven piles, and caissons.
responsibilities: Calculate ultimate and allowable bearing capacity of soils and rocks
Analyze pile axial friction, end bearing, and lateral load response
Model mat foundations on elastomeric subgrade springs in SAFE
Interpret pile load testing and wave equation pile driving analysis

geotechnical-investigation-engineer.name: Geotechnical Site Investigation Engineer
geotechnical-investigation-engineer.description: Field specialist supervising borehole drilling, in-situ soil testing, piezometer installations, and sample logging.
responsibilities: Manage drilling rigs, CPT trucks, and field sampling teams
Execute Standard Penetration Tests (SPT) and vane shear tests
Prepare borehole stratigraphy logs and undisturbed sampling records
Maintain quality assurance for field testing and sample transfer

geotechnical-fem-engineer.name: Geotechnical Finite Element (FEA) Specialist
geotechnical-fem-engineer.description: Advanced specialist modeling non-linear soil-structure interaction, staged excavations, and tunneling in PLAXIS and GTS NX.
responsibilities: Build 2D and 3D finite element numerical meshes in PLAXIS and MIDAS GTS NX
Calibrate constitutive soil models (Hardening Soil, Soft Soil Creep)
Analyze ground movement, pore pressure dissipation, and tunnel lining forces
Provide numerical safety checks for complex urban mega-projects

slope-stability-engineer.name: Slope Stability & Landslide Remediation Specialist
slope-stability-engineer.description: Specialist in analyzing natural/cut slopes, landslide hazards, and designing soil nailing, anchors, and slope drainage.
responsibilities: Perform limit equilibrium slope stability analysis in SLOPE/W and Slide2
Design soil nail walls, ground tieback anchors, and rock catch fences
Evaluate seismic pseudo-static slope stability and rainfall-induced seepage
Inspect emergency landslide sites and specify stabilization repairs

forensic-geotechnical-engineer.name: Forensic Geotechnical Engineer
forensic-geotechnical-engineer.description: Expert investigator analyzing foundation distress, slope failures, ground distress, and providing expert testimony.
responsibilities: Investigate building cracks, excessive differential settlement, and foundation failures
Conduct post-failure subsurface sampling and back-analysis
Determine root cause of geotechnical distress and recommend underpinning
Author expert technical reports for legal and insurance arbitration

transportation-engineer.name: Transportation Infrastructure Engineer
transportation-engineer.description: Generalist professional planning, designing, and operating multi-modal transportation networks, roadways, and public transit infrastructure.
responsibilities: Develop feasibility studies for urban transportation projects
Design roadway alignments, intersections, and drainage systems
Perform traffic capacity evaluations and signal optimization
Coordinate multi-disciplinary transport infrastructure projects

traffic-engineer.name: Traffic & Operations Engineer
traffic-engineer.description: Specialist in analyzing traffic flow, signal timing, intersection capacity, and traffic control devices to reduce congestion and improve safety.
responsibilities: Conduct peak hour turning movement counts and speed surveys
Optimize traffic signal timing and signal coordination in Synchro
Perform intersection capacity analysis according to HCM guidelines
Design traffic sign, signal, and pavement marking plans

highway-design-engineer.name: Highway Geometric Design Engineer
highway-design-engineer.description: Engineers specializing in 3D horizontal/vertical corridor modeling, cross-section design, interchanges, and earthworks in Civil 3D/OpenRoads.
responsibilities: Design 3D highway alignments, vertical curves, and superelevation diagrams
Create parametric corridor assemblies and target surfaces in Civil 3D
Calculate earthwork mass-haul balances and construction quantities
Ensure alignment compliance with AASHTO Green Book standards

transportation-planner.name: Transportation Planner
transportation-planner.description: Professional modeling regional mobility demand, transit-oriented development (TOD), origin-destination trends, and long-range transport policies.
responsibilities: Calibrate 4-step regional travel demand forecasting models in TransCAD/Visum
Analyze socio-economic growth impacts on transport corridors
Develop Transit-Oriented Development (TOD) station master plans
Evaluate multi-modal transport policy and capital allocation programs

traffic-modeling-engineer.name: Traffic Simulation & Modeling Engineer
traffic-modeling-engineer.description: Specialist building microscopic and macroscopic traffic simulation models to evaluate complex junctions, freeways, and transit networks.
responsibilities: Develop microscopic simulation networks in PTV Vissim and Aimsun
Calibrate driver behavior car-following parameters against field counts
Simulate weaving sections, toll plazas, and transit priority lanes
Present 3D traffic simulation visualizations to stakeholders

pavement-engineer.name: Pavement Structural Design Engineer
pavement-engineer.description: Materials and structural engineer designing flexible asphalt and rigid concrete pavement layer thicknesses and managing roadway assets.
responsibilities: Calculate 20-year cumulative design traffic ESALs
Design flexible and rigid pavement structural layer thicknesses (AASHTO / MEPDG)
Analyze FWD non-destructive deflection data for structural capacity
Specify Superpave asphalt mixes and concrete pavement joint details

railway-engineer.name: Railway Track & Infrastructure Engineer
railway-engineer.description: Specialist in heavy-rail and urban rail track alignment geometry, turnout design, slab track systems, and trackbed stability.
responsibilities: Design 3D track horizontal alignments, cant, and transition curves in OpenRail
Select rail profiles, sleepers, fastenings, and turnout geometries
Analyze trackbed subgrade stresses and ballast thickness requirements
Verify structural clearance envelopes against AREMA standards

airport-engineer.name: Airport Airside Infrastructure Engineer
airport-engineer.description: Specialist designing runway geometric alignments, taxiway safety fillets, airfield pavements, and apron parking layouts.
responsibilities: Perform wind rose analysis for optimal runway orientation
Design runway length, taxiway geometry, and safety areas to FAA standards
Calculate airfield flexible/rigid pavement thickness using FAARFIELD
Layout terminal gate stand geometry and aircraft apron taxilanes

transit-planning-engineer.name: Public Transit & BRT Systems Engineer
transit-planning-engineer.description: Specialist planning Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) networks, metro feeder lines, route timetabling, station design, and transit operations.
responsibilities: Design dedicated BRT busway corridors and median platform stations
Calculate route headways, run times, and bus fleet requirements
Optimize transit signal priority (TSP) timing at signalized junctions
Evaluate transit system capacity and passenger level of service

traffic-simulation-engineer.name: Macroscopic & Microscopic Traffic Simulation Specialist
traffic-simulation-engineer.description: Advanced engineer executing regional macroscopic assignment and microscopic bottleneck simulation for mega-infrastructure projects.
responsibilities: Construct multi-modal macroscopic traffic assignment models in Visum
Perform microscopic congestion analysis for complex freeway interchanges
Evaluate traffic mitigation scenarios for bridge and tunnel approaches
Validate simulation models against real-time probe speed datasets

transportation-gis-engineer.name: Transport Spatial Data & GIS Specialist
transportation-gis-engineer.description: GIS professional building transport network graphs, running spatial accessibility modeling, and managing highway asset databases.
responsibilities: Build vector transportation network datasets in ArcGIS Network Analyst
Model travel time isochrone accessibility zones for urban transit
Process GPS probe vehicle and cellular origin-destination location data
Develop web GIS dashboards for highway asset maintenance tracking

road-safety-engineer.name: Road Safety Auditor & Collision Specialist
road-safety-engineer.description: Safety specialist conducting formal road safety audits, crash blackspot statistical analysis, and forgiving roadside safety design.
responsibilities: Conduct Stage 1 to Stage 4 formal Road Safety Audits (RSA)
Analyze crash collision databases and identify high-frequency blackspots
Design speed management countermeasures and forgiving roadside barriers
Author safety audit compliance reports for transportation agencies

transportation-data-analyst.name: Transportation Mobility Data Analyst
transportation-data-analyst.description: Data scientist/engineer analyzing big mobility data, cellular origin-destination matrix data, and smart city traffic sensors.
responsibilities: Clean and process large probe GPS, Bluetooth, and cellular travel datasets
Extract origin-destination matrices and travel time delay metrics
Develop predictive traffic congestion algorithms using Python/R
Visualize mobility trends for smart city traffic management centers

its-engineer.name: Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) Engineer
its-engineer.description: Specialist designing advanced traffic management systems (ATMS), SCATS/SCOOT adaptive signals, CCTV surveillance, and CAV V2X systems.
responsibilities: Design traffic management center (TMC) system architecture
Deploy adaptive signal control systems (SCATS / SCOOT / InSync)
Specify CCTV surveillance, loop detector, and Variable Message Sign networks
Prepare infrastructure specifications for Connected & Autonomous Vehicles (V2X)

water-resources-engineer.name: Water Resources Engineer
water-resources-engineer.description: Specialist who plans, analyzes, and manages river basins, water supply yield, climate impacts, and integrated water resources systems.
responsibilities: Conduct river basin water balance and yield reliability studies
Develop integrated water resources management (IWRM) plans
Analyze climate change impacts on rainfall and drought resilience
Coordinate multi-sectoral water allocation models

hydrologist.name: Hydrologist & Hydrologic Modeler
hydrologist.description: Engineering scientist specializing in rainfall-runoff processes, flood hydrograph forecasting, and hydrologic statistical modeling.
responsibilities: Delineate catchments and calculate rainfall-runoff parameters
Develop and calibrate HEC-HMS and rainfall-runoff models
Perform extreme rainfall frequency and IDF curve analysis
Provide flood hydrograph inputs for bridge and dam hydraulics

flood-modeling-engineer.name: Flood Risk & 1D/2D Hydrodynamic Modeling Engineer
flood-modeling-engineer.description: Engineers dedicated to 1D and 2D flood inundation modeling, floodplain mapping, and designing flood mitigation infrastructure.
responsibilities: Build 1D/2D hydraulic flood models using HEC-RAS or MIKE 21
Prepare hazard and risk flood maps for government authorities
Evaluate flood wall, levee, and retention pond performance
Develop real-time flood forecasting and early warning systems

river-engineer.name: River & Morphological Design Engineer
river-engineer.description: Engineer specializing in river hydraulics, channel morphology, bank erosion control, sediment transport, and river dredging.
responsibilities: Design river training structures, revetments, and spur dikes
Analyze sediment transport rates and scour at bridge piers
Plan river dredging channels and bank stabilization works
Assess river channel meandering and erosion risks

water-treatment-engineer.name: Water Treatment Process Engineer
water-treatment-engineer.description: Process engineer who designs drinking water treatment plants (WTP), membrane systems, and chemical dosing facilities.
responsibilities: Perform chemical dosing calculations and jar testing protocols
Design clarifiers, rapid sand filters, and membrane filtration
Develop hydraulic profile across WTP treatment trains
Specify chemical dosing pumps and chlorination systems

wastewater-engineer.name: Wastewater Treatment & Process Engineer
wastewater-engineer.description: Specialist in biological wastewater treatment (WWTP), activated sludge, biological nutrient removal, and sludge processing.
responsibilities: Size aeration basins, oxygenation capacity, and RAS/WAS rates
Design secondary clarifiers and nutrient removal systems
Specify anaerobic digesters and mechanical sludge dewatering
Ensure treated effluent meets environmental discharge limits

drainage-engineer.name: Urban Stormwater & Drainage Engineer
drainage-engineer.description: Engineer designing urban drainage networks, detention ponds, box culverts, and green stormwater infrastructure (SUDS).
responsibilities: Size urban storm sewer pipes, gutters, and curb inlets
Model stormwater runoff networks using EPA SWMM
Design stormwater detention basins and culvert structures
Implement Sustainable Drainage Systems (SUDS/LID)

irrigation-engineer.name: Irrigation & Agricultural Water Engineer
irrigation-engineer.description: Engineer who plans and designs canal distribution networks, crop water scheduling, pressurized drip systems, and drainage.
responsibilities: Calculate crop water requirements and duty/delta parameters
Design gravity irrigation canal networks and cross-regulators
Layout pressurized drip and sprinkler irrigation piping
Design agricultural land subsurface drainage systems

groundwater-engineer.name: Groundwater & Hydrogeological Engineer
groundwater-engineer.description: Hydrogeologist specializing in groundwater extraction, tubewell design, aquifer yield analysis, and MODFLOW numerical modeling.
responsibilities: Analyze pumping test data to calculate aquifer parameters
Develop 3D groundwater flow and transport models in MODFLOW
Design deep tubewells and gravel pack specifications
Assess saline intrusion and managed aquifer recharge (MAR)

smart-water-engineer.name: Smart Water & Network Telemetry Specialist
smart-water-engineer.description: Engineer combining water network hydraulics with SCADA telemetry, IoT pressure sensors, and digital twin analytics for leak detection.
responsibilities: Design District Metered Areas (DMAs) and install PRVs
Integrate real-time IoT pressure/flow telemetry with SCADA
Calibrate online water network digital twins
Analyze real-time data for non-revenue water (NRW) leak detection

water-quality-engineer.name: Water Quality Engineer
water-quality-engineer.description: Specialist focused on physicochemical/microbiological testing, source water protection, water quality modeling, and environmental compliance.
responsibilities: Perform physicochemical and microbiological water testing and analysis
Model dissolved oxygen sag and nutrient transport in river systems
Design source water protection zones and catchment management plans
Ensure compliance with drinking water and industrial effluent standards

environmental-engineer.name: Environmental Engineer
environmental-engineer.description: Engineers who apply scientific and engineering principles to protect human health, reduce environmental pollution, and design sustainable control systems.
responsibilities: Design pollution control systems for air, water, soil, and solid waste
Conduct environmental impact assessments (EIA) and regulatory compliance audits
Perform field sampling and atmospheric dispersion or contaminant transport modelling
Prepare Environmental Management Plans (EMP) for industrial and infrastructure projects

sanitary-engineer.name: Sanitary Engineer
sanitary-engineer.description: Specialists in public health engineering, municipal sanitation, fecal sludge management (FSM), and hygienic waste management systems.
responsibilities: Design municipal and institutional sanitation facilities and service chains
Engineering fecal sludge treatment plants (FSTP) and septage management systems
Plan non-sewered sanitation (NSS) and public hygiene infrastructure
Collaborate with urban authorities on city-wide inclusive sanitation (CWIS)

air-quality-engineer.name: Air Quality Engineer
air-quality-engineer.description: Engineers specializing in air pollution measurement, stack emission testing, atmospheric dispersion modeling, and air filtration system design.
responsibilities: Execute atmospheric dispersion modeling using AERMOD and CALPUFF
Design industrial air pollution control equipment (cyclones, baghouse filters, scrubbers)
Manage continuous ambient air monitoring stations (CAMS)
Prepare industrial emissions inventories and greenhouse gas accounting

solid-waste-engineer.name: Solid Waste & Landfill Engineer
solid-waste-engineer.description: Engineers who plan solid waste management systems, material recovery facilities (MRF), waste-to-energy plants, and sanitary landfills.
responsibilities: Design composite geomembrane liners, leachate collection, and landfill gas extraction
Optimize municipal solid waste collection logistics and transfer station networks
Design organic waste composting and anaerobic digestion facilities
Oversee landfill post-closure environmental monitoring and gas flaring

eia-environmental-consultant.name: EIA & Environmental Compliance Specialist
eia-environmental-consultant.description: Consultants who conduct environmental baseline studies, predict environmental impacts, and guide projects through regulatory clearance.
responsibilities: Lead Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) and Strategic Environmental Assessment (SEA) studies
Draft Environmental Management Plans (EMP) and monitoring protocols
Coordinate public stakeholder consultations and regulatory submissions to DoE
Audit industrial plants for ISO 14001 compliance and environmental performance

environmental-monitoring-specialist.name: Environmental Monitoring & QA/QC Specialist
environmental-monitoring-specialist.description: Specialists focused on multi-media environmental field sampling, analytical testing, and environmental data quality control.
responsibilities: Design environmental field sampling networks for air, surface/groundwater, soil, and noise
Operate analytical instrumentation (GC-MS, AAS, spectrophotometers)
Maintain strict sample chain of custody and laboratory QA/QC protocols
Analyze environmental monitoring data against national and international standards

remediation-engineer.name: Remediation & Contaminated Site Engineer
remediation-engineer.description: Engineers who investigate brownfields, contaminated soils, and groundwater plumes, and design in-situ/ex-situ cleanup systems.
responsibilities: Conduct Phase I and Phase II Environmental Site Assessments (ESA)
Delineate soil contamination and LNAPL/DNAPL groundwater plumes
Design remediation systems (Pump & Treat, Soil Vapor Extraction, ISCO, Bioremediation)
Monitor remediation progress until regulatory site closure clearance

sustainability-lca-engineer.name: Sustainability & Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) Engineer
sustainability-lca-engineer.description: Engineers who model environmental life cycle impacts, carbon footprints, circular economy systems, and corporate ESG metrics.
responsibilities: Perform Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) according to ISO 14040/14044 using openLCA or SimaPro
Quantify Scope 1, 2, and 3 corporate greenhouse gas (GHG) carbon footprints
Design circular material flow strategies and eco-industrial symbiosis
Prepare Environmental Product Declarations (EPD) and ESG sustainability reports

construction-manager.name: Construction Manager
construction-manager.description: Oversees day-to-day site execution, contractor management, schedule adherence, quality assurance, safety, and operational budget.

construction-project-manager.name: Construction Project Manager
construction-project-manager.description: Leads overall construction project delivery from tendering to handover, managing cost, time, scope, contracts, stakeholders, and risks.

site-engineer.name: Site / Construction Engineer
site-engineer.description: Directs daily site operations, supervises labor and subcontractors, verifies structural work compliance, and maintains site records.

planning-scheduling-engineer.name: Planning & Scheduling Engineer
planning-scheduling-engineer.description: Develops and updates CPM schedules in Primavera P6, tracks progress, conducts delay analysis, and generates project control reports.

quantity-surveyor-cost-engineer.name: Quantity Surveyor / Cost Engineer
quantity-surveyor-cost-engineer.description: Responsible for material quantity takeoffs, BOQ preparation, interim valuation certificates, variation pricing, and cost control.

procurement-contract-engineer.name: Procurement & Contract Engineer
procurement-contract-engineer.description: Manages tender preparation, vendor selection, subcontract negotiation, FIDIC contract administration, and variation processing.

construction-qaqc-engineer.name: Construction QA/QC Engineer
construction-qaqc-engineer.description: Enforces quality plans, conducts field inspections, reviews material submittals, oversees lab testing, and resolves non-conformances.

construction-hse-engineer.name: Construction Health & Safety (HSE) Engineer
construction-hse-engineer.description: Establishes site safety protocols, conducts job hazard assessments, issues work permits, and enforces OSHA/ISO 45001 compliance.

claims-delay-analyst.name: Forensic Delay & Claims Analyst
claims-delay-analyst.description: Specializes in schedule forensic analysis, delay event quantification, Extension of Time (EOT) claim packages, and dispute resolution.

construction-bim-coordinator.name: Digital Construction & BIM Coordinator
construction-bim-coordinator.description: Coordinates 3D/4D/5D BIM models, manages spatial clash detection, integrates schedules with Navisworks/Synchro, and maintains CDE.

responsibilities: Design urban roads, storm sewers, and public facility infrastructure
Coordinate underground utility works with telecom, power, and gas agencies
Review private development municipal infrastructure compliance
Supervise municipal construction contractors and maintenance works
municipal-engineer.name: Municipal & Urban Infrastructure Engineer
municipal-engineer.description: Engineers responsible for planning, designing, constructing, and maintaining public municipal infrastructure including local roads, drainage, water supply, and public amenities.

responsibilities: Prepare municipal infrastructure capital improvement plans (CIP)
Assess long-range water, drainage, and waste capacity requirements
Coordinate master planning with city corporations and urban authorities
Analyze spatial urban growth scenarios using GIS tools
urban-infrastructure-planner.name: Urban Infrastructure Master Planner
urban-infrastructure-planner.description: Specialists who formulate citywide infrastructure master plans, forecast utility demands, draft capital improvement budgets, and align infrastructure with land-use plans.

responsibilities: Manage ASCE 38 subsurface utility surveys and GPR field investigations
Build 3D subsurface utility CAD corridor models and perform clash audits
Chair multi-agency utility relocation and trenching coordination boards
Issue municipal utility excavation permits and inspect reinstatement
utility-coordination-engineer.name: Underground Utility & Corridor Coordination Engineer
utility-coordination-engineer.description: Engineers specialized in subsurface utility engineering (SUE), utility mapping, multi-agency clash resolution, and right-of-way corridor allocation.

responsibilities: Maintain municipal GIS asset register for roads, drains, and utilities
Develop asset decay curves and condition rating inspection standards
Prioritize risk-based infrastructure renewal and rehabilitation budgets
Track lifecycle maintenance costs and asset performance metrics
municipal-asset-manager.name: Municipal Infrastructure Asset Manager
municipal-asset-manager.description: Professionals who oversee municipal asset registers, establish ISO 55000 asset management frameworks, execute condition audits, and plan capital renewals.

responsibilities: Manage citywide enterprise GIS database for land parcels, roads, and utilities
Develop mobile GIS applications for field inspector asset data entry
Publish spatial web GIS maps and city dashboard visualizations
Perform spatial network analysis for waste routing and water service
municipal-gis-specialist.name: Municipal GIS & Urban Spatial Data Specialist
municipal-gis-specialist.description: Experts in designing, deploying, and maintaining enterprise spatial data infrastructure (SDI), utility geodatabases, and municipal web maps.

responsibilities: Design smart street lighting mesh communication networks and sensors
Deploy IoT water level and flow telemetry sensors across storm drains
Integrate automated water meter reading (AMI) into utility databases
Develop central command dashboard for real-time city infrastructure alerts
smart-city-infrastructure-engineer.name: Smart City & Connected Infrastructure Engineer
smart-city-infrastructure-engineer.description: Engineers who integrate IoT sensors, smart street lighting networks, automated telemetry, and digital twins into municipal infrastructure operations.

responsibilities: Conduct urban climate risk and flood vulnerability spatial mapping
Design nature-based solutions including bioswales, rain gardens, and wetlands
Incorporate climate change allowance factors into storm drainage design
Develop municipal emergency utility backup plans for extreme weather events
urban-resilience-engineer.name: Urban Resilience & Climate Adaptation Engineer
urban-resilience-engineer.description: Specialists who design climate-adapted urban infrastructure, sponge city drainage systems, urban heat mitigation, and disaster backup utilities.

coastal-engineer.name: Coastal Engineer
coastal-engineer.description: Specialist civil engineer designing coastal protection structures, analyzing wave dynamics, and managing shoreline processes.

port-harbor-engineer.name: Port & Harbor Civil Engineer
port-harbor-engineer.description: Civil engineer specializing in port master planning, quay wall structural engineering, jetties, berthing dolphins, and harbor layouts.

dredging-navigation-engineer.name: Dredging & Navigation Engineer
dredging-navigation-engineer.description: Maritime engineer managing navigation channel design, capital dredging projects, dredger fleet selection, and spoil management.

coastal-modelling-engineer.name: Coastal Hydrodynamic & Wave Modelling Specialist
coastal-modelling-engineer.description: Specialist engineer creating 2D/3D numerical models of coastal currents, wave transformation, storm surge, and sediment transport.

coastal-protection-engineer.name: Coastal Protection & Revetment Engineer
coastal-protection-engineer.description: Engineer dedicated to designing breakwaters, revetments, seawalls, coastal dikes, and beach nourishment protection systems.

coastal-resilience-specialist.name: Coastal Resilience & Climate Adaptation Specialist
coastal-resilience-specialist.description: Specialist evaluating sea level rise vulnerabilities, designing nature-based shoreline defenses, and implementing adaptive coastal plans.

river-hydraulics-engineer.name: River Hydraulics & Open Channel Engineer
river-hydraulics-engineer.description: Specialist responsible for open channel flow calculations, backwater profiling, energy dissipation design, and river channel hydraulic sizing.

river-morphology-specialist.name: River Morphology & Fluvial Geomorphologist
river-morphology-specialist.description: Expert analyzing river planform changes, meander migration rates, bed aggradation/degradation, and long-term river stability.

riverbank-protection-engineer.name: Riverbank Protection & Revetment Engineer
riverbank-protection-engineer.description: Professional specializing in geobag revetments, CC block mattresses, slope stability, launching aprons, and erosion hotspot protection.

river-training-engineer.name: River Training & Channel Stabilization Engineer
river-training-engineer.description: Specialist designing groynes, spurs, guide bunds, porcupine screens, and channel alignment schemes for river training.

bridge-hydraulics-scour-engineer.name: Bridge Hydraulics & Scour Specialist
bridge-hydraulics-scour-engineer.description: Engineer computing waterway opening clearances, bridge afflux, pier/contraction scour depths, and designing scour countermeasures.

inland-waterway-engineer.name: Inland Waterway & Dredging Engineer
inland-waterway-engineer.description: Professional managing navigation fairway design, draft clearance maintenance, vessel turning basins, and river dredging operations.

river-restoration-engineer.name: River Restoration & Bioengineering Specialist
river-restoration-engineer.description: Practitioner implementing nature-based bank protection, riparian habitat restoration, fish passes, and environmental flow regimes.

river-basin-engineer.name: River Basin Master Planner & IWRM Specialist
river-basin-engineer.description: Senior consultant leading integrated river basin water resources planning, transboundary river agreements, and basin-wide flood strategies.

land-surveyor.name: Professional Land Surveyor
land-surveyor.description: Executes boundary demarcation, parcel mapping, land subdivision, property records, and cadastral field surveys.

engineering-surveyor.name: Engineering & Alignment Surveyor
engineering-surveyor.description: Specializes in site topography, road route alignment, civil infrastructure control networks, and volume measurements.

construction-surveyor.name: Construction Layout & Staking Surveyor
construction-surveyor.description: Responsible for building grid setting out, foundation positioning, structural alignment, and as-built verification on site.

geodetic-surveyor.name: Geodetic Survey Engineer / Geodesist
geodetic-surveyor.description: Establishes primary national/regional geodetic control networks, datum transformations, CORS management, and high-precision positioning.

geomatics-engineer.name: Geomatics Engineer
geomatics-engineer.description: Combines surveying engineering, spatial data processing, GIS, remote sensing, and 3D reality capture into integrated civil solutions.

gis-engineer-analyst.name: GIS Engineer / Spatial Analyst
gis-engineer-analyst.description: Develops geodatabases, performs spatial overlay and network analytics, builds Web GIS web apps, and manages enterprise GIS systems.

remote-sensing-specialist.name: Remote Sensing & Earth Observation Specialist
remote-sensing-specialist.description: Analyzes satellite multispectral/radar imagery, conducts land cover classification, environmental monitoring, and change detection.

photogrammetrist-uav-specialist.name: Photogrammetrist & UAV Drone Mapping Specialist
photogrammetrist-uav-specialist.description: Plans drone survey flights, processes aerial photography, generates orthomosaics, point clouds, and DTMs for engineering projects.

hydrographic-surveyor.name: Hydrographic & Bathymetric Surveyor
hydrographic-surveyor.description: Executes offshore, river, and harbor bathymetric surveys using multibeam echosounders, acoustic positioning, and nautical charting tools.

lidar-point-cloud-specialist.name: LiDAR & 3D Point Cloud Processing Specialist
lidar-point-cloud-specialist.description: Processes airborne, terrestrial, and mobile laser scan data, performs ground classification, and converts point clouds to BIM geometry.
